catalogue_gps_dropout_single_run.catalogue_description: GPS dropout 25-33 s: no fix — trust must HOLD, not false-alarm

conditioning: every run flies the same trajectory (csia/validation.py comment; tests/test_flight_truth_determinism.py)
every run uses the same sensor noise: csia/scenarios.make_sensors fixes seeds 1-8
what varies is fault class, amplitude scale in [0.5, 2.0), onset in [15, 35) s, and the clean/faulted split
